items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: And, of course, Nat Nazarra, Sr., he passed some years ago. He passed in 1959, I think.

ctx.x: John Barner, that's one of Nat Nazarra's sons. What's the fellow that plays Mannix, O'Connor, he's another one, John Ireland. That's big brother John. He's one. And then there's Cliff Nazarra and Nat Nazarra, Jr. They're all alive. They're still alive.
And then -- well, the only one that's passed already is Mr. Buck. And, of course, Nat Nazarra, Sr., he passed some years ago. He passed in 1959, I think.
So here was this white family that had an act. And they introduced these blacks in their act to add the comedy.
